sections.title: Create Shell Variables
sections.content:
Define PRICE_PER_APPLE=5, MyFirstLetters=ABC and greeting with eight internal spaces; keep quoting when printing.

```bash
#!/bin/bash
PRICE_PER_APPLE=5
MyFirstLetters=ABC
greeting='Hello        world!'
printf 'Price per apple: %s
My first letters: %s
Greeting: %s
' "$PRICE_PER_APPLE" "$MyFirstLetters" "$greeting"
```
sections.content_vi:
Khai báo PRICE_PER_APPLE=5, MyFirstLetters=ABC và greeting có tám dấu cách bên trong; đặt biến trong dấu nháy khi in.

sections.title: Referencing Shell Variables
sections.title_vi: Truy xuất giá trị của biến
sections.content:
Compare escaped dollar signs, braced expansion and quoted versus unquoted spaces.

```bash
#!/bin/bash
PRICE_PER_APPLE=5
MyFirstLetters=ABC
greeting='Hello        world!'
echo "The price of an Apple today is: \$HK $PRICE_PER_APPLE"
echo "The first 10 letters in the alphabet are: ${MyFirstLetters}DEFGHIJ"
echo $greeting
echo "$greeting"
```
sections.content_vi:
So sánh dấu đô la được escape, mở rộng biến với ngoặc nhọn và khoảng trắng khi có hoặc không có dấu nháy.

```bash
#!/bin/bash
PRICE_PER_APPLE=5
MyFirstLetters=ABC
greeting='Hello        world!'
echo "The price of an Apple today is: \$HK $PRICE_PER_APPLE"
echo "The first 10 letters in the alphabet are: ${MyFirstLetters}DEFGHIJ"
echo $greeting
echo "$greeting"
```

sections.title: Command Substitution
sections.title_vi: Gán kết quả lệnh vào biến (Command Substitution)
sections.content:
Capture date, directory listing and readable uptime in variables.

```bash
CURRENT_DATE=$(date +%Y-%m-%d)
FILES_IN_DIR=$(ls)
UPTIME=$(uptime -p)
echo "Today's date is: $CURRENT_DATE"
printf 'Files in the current directory:
%s
System uptime: %s
' "$FILES_IN_DIR" "$UPTIME"
```
sections.content_vi:
Lưu ngày hiện tại, danh sách thư mục và thời gian hoạt động dễ đọc vào các biến.

```bash

FILES_IN_DIR=$(ls)
UPTIME=$(uptime -p)
echo "Today's date is: $CURRENT_DATE"
printf 'Files in the current directory:
%s
System uptime: %s
' "$FILES_IN_DIR" "$UPTIME"
```

sections.title: Arithmetic Operations
sections.title_vi: Phép tính số học với biến
sections.content:
Create arithmetic.sh; use X=10 and Y=5 for arithmetic, then increment X and decrement Y.

```bash
#!/bin/bash
X=10
Y=5
SUM=$((X+Y)); DIFF=$((X-Y)); PRODUCT=$((X*Y)); QUOTIENT=$((X/Y)); REMAINDER=$((X%Y))
echo "Sum of $X and $Y is: $SUM"
echo "Difference between $X and $Y is: $DIFF"
echo "Product of $X and $Y is: $PRODUCT"
echo "Quotient of $X divided by $Y is: $QUOTIENT"
echo "Remainder of $X divided by $Y is: $REMAINDER"
X=$((X+1)); echo "After incrementing, X is now: $X"
Y=$((Y-1)); echo "After decrementing, Y is now: $Y"
```
sections.content_vi:
Tạo arithmetic.sh; dùng X=10, Y=5 để tính toán, sau đó tăng X và giảm Y một đơn vị.

```bash
#!/bin/bash
X=10
Y=5
SUM=$((X+Y)); DIFF=$((X-Y)); PRODUCT=$((X*Y)); QUOTIENT=$((X/Y)); REMAINDER=$((X%Y))
echo "Sum of $X and $Y is: $SUM"
echo "Difference between $X and $Y is: $DIFF"
echo "Product of $X and $Y is: $PRODUCT"
echo "Quotient of $X divided by $Y is: $QUOTIENT"
echo "Remainder of $X divided by $Y is: $REMAINDER"
X=$((X+1)); echo "After incrementing, X is now: $X"
Y=$((Y-1)); echo "After decrementing, Y is now: $Y"
```

sections.title: Using Environment Variables
sections.title_vi: Sử dụng biến môi trường hệ thống
sections.content:
Use environment.sh to display environment values, export MY_VARIABLE to a child Bash, then unset it. Shell paths depend on the runtime.

```bash
#!/bin/bash
echo "Home directory: $HOME"
echo "Current user: $LOGNAME"
echo "Shell being used: $SHELL"
echo "Current PATH: $PATH"
export MY_VARIABLE="Hello from my variable"
echo "My new variable: $MY_VARIABLE"
bash -c 'echo "MY_VARIABLE in child process: $MY_VARIABLE"'
unset MY_VARIABLE
echo "MY_VARIABLE after unsetting: $MY_VARIABLE"
```
sections.content_vi:
Trong environment.sh, xem biến môi trường, export MY_VARIABLE cho Bash con rồi unset. Đường dẫn shell phụ thuộc môi trường đang dùng.

```bash
#!/bin/bash
echo "Home directory: $HOME"
echo "Current user: $LOGNAME"
echo "Shell being used: $SHELL"
echo "Current PATH: $PATH"
export MY_VARIABLE="Hello from my variable"
echo "My new variable: $MY_VARIABLE"
bash -c 'echo "MY_VARIABLE in child process: $MY_VARIABLE"'
unset MY_VARIABLE
echo "MY_VARIABLE after unsetting: $MY_VARIABLE"
```

steps.title: Arithmetic Operations
steps.title_vi: Phép tính số học với biến
steps.content:
Create arithmetic.sh; use X=10 and Y=5 for arithmetic, then increment X and decrement Y.

```bash
#!/bin/bash
X=10
Y=5
SUM=$((X+Y)); DIFF=$((X-Y)); PRODUCT=$((X*Y)); QUOTIENT=$((X/Y)); REMAINDER=$((X%Y))
echo "Sum of $X and $Y is: $SUM"
echo "Difference between $X and $Y is: $DIFF"
echo "Product of $X and $Y is: $PRODUCT"
echo "Quotient of $X divided by $Y is: $QUOTIENT"
echo "Remainder of $X divided by $Y is: $REMAINDER"
X=$((X+1)); echo "After incrementing, X is now: $X"
Y=$((Y-1)); echo "After decrementing, Y is now: $Y"
```

steps.title: Using Environment Variables
steps.title_vi: Sử dụng biến môi trường hệ thống
steps.content:
Use environment.sh to display environment values, export MY_VARIABLE to a child Bash, then unset it. Shell paths depend on the runtime.

```bash
#!/bin/bash
echo "Home directory: $HOME"
echo "Current user: $LOGNAME"
echo "Shell being used: $SHELL"
echo "Current PATH: $PATH"
export MY_VARIABLE="Hello from my variable"
echo "My new variable: $MY_VARIABLE"
bash -c 'echo "MY_VARIABLE in child process: $MY_VARIABLE"'
unset MY_VARIABLE
echo "MY_VARIABLE after unsetting: $MY_VARIABLE"
```
steps.content_vi:
Trong environment.sh, xem biến môi trường, export MY_VARIABLE cho Bash con rồi unset. Đường dẫn shell phụ thuộc môi trường đang dùng.
